findings.highlight: She feels heavy and dizzy
findings.evidenceJa: 鈍く、熱を伴った目眩がする
findings.governingReading: Sakura experiences a dull dizziness accompanied by heat.
findings.explanation: The heat accompanying the dizziness disappears and 鈍く becomes bodily heaviness.

findings.highlight: The monotonous ticking of the clock
findings.evidenceJa: 狂いなくリズムを刻む時計
findings.governingReading: The clock marks an unfailing, exact rhythm.
findings.explanation: Precision becomes monotony, adding an affective judgment while losing the clock’s exactness.

findings.highlight: the painful thumping of her heart
findings.evidenceJa: 苦しそうに血を送る心臓
findings.governingReading: Her heart sounds as though it is laboriously sending blood.
findings.explanation: The circulation image disappears and apparent strain becomes generic painful thumping.

findings.highlight: she waited eagerly for his return
findings.evidenceJa: この屋敷の本当の住人が帰ってくるのを心待ちにしていた
findings.governingReading: She eagerly awaits the return of the mansion’s true resident, defining herself against Shirou’s ownership of the home.
findings.explanation: The relational “true resident” formulation disappears.

findings.highlight: Her fever is so high that it makes her imagine such a thing, and the abnormality is unprecedented
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の熱は高く、際限がなく、前例がないほど異常だった
findings.governingReading: Her internal heat is high, limitless, and unprecedentedly abnormal.
findings.explanation: Heat is diagnosed as fever and its boundlessness is omitted.

findings.highlight: The sensation is strange and unpleasant
findings.evidenceJa: 奇怪といえば奇怪だったし、不快といえば不快だった
findings.governingReading: The sensation can be called strange and, from another angle, unpleasant.
findings.explanation: The reflective parallel qualification is flattened into two categorical adjectives.

findings.highlight: It’s shared by the things in her body
findings.evidenceJa: 体のなか、血管とか神経とかの間を這っていくモノたちもタイヘンそうだ
findings.governingReading: The things crawling inside her also seem to be struggling.
findings.explanation: The English asserts shared pain and drops Sakura’s observational uncertainty.

findings.highlight: the things within her
findings.evidenceJa: 体の中で蠢く[ruby text=それら char=2]子犬
findings.governingReading: The written puppies are simultaneously read as “those things,” sustaining Sakura’s disturbing affectionate metaphor.
findings.explanation: The English retains only the abstract referent and loses the puppy image at the point of identification.

findings.highlight: He should be back
findings.evidenceJa: きっと帰ってくる
findings.governingReading: Sakura is confident Shirou will return.
findings.explanation: Her certainty becomes an expectation of what ought probably to happen.

findings.highlight: She has been disciplined and reformed many times since she was a child
findings.evidenceJa: 子供の頃から何度も体験し、静め方も教わっている
findings.governingReading: She has experienced the symptoms repeatedly since childhood and was taught how to calm them.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces experience and symptom management with repeated discipline and reformation, implying punitive conditioning.

findings.highlight: She has never been able to
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで出来たコトが出来ない
findings.governingReading: Sakura cannot now do something she had previously been able to do.
findings.explanation: The temporal logic is reversed into lifelong inability.

findings.highlight: barefooted
findings.evidenceJa: 土足のまま
findings.governingReading: Shinji enters without removing his outdoor shoes.
findings.explanation: The English states the physical opposite.

findings.highlight: Did I use Rider too much
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーを使いすぎた反動かな
findings.governingReading: Shinji speculates that Sakura’s state may be backlash from her overuse of Rider.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shinji himself the user whose overuse caused the reaction.

findings.highlight: you’re getting all hot and horny by yourself
findings.evidenceJa: こんな所にひとりで
findings.governingReading: Shinji finds Sakura alone in the living room.
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts explicit sexual humiliation.

findings.highlight: She tries to run, but can’t muster the strength
findings.evidenceJa: 体に力が入らない
findings.governingReading: Sakura cannot put strength into her body.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents an attempt to run.

findings.highlight: she had no will to run away from the start
findings.evidenceJa: もとより体を動かす気力も湧かない
findings.governingReading: She cannot summon even the will to move her body.
findings.explanation: The mature branch narrows bodily immobility into a will to escape.

findings.highlight: Even if she gets away[line3]she can never truly escape
findings.evidenceJa: もとより体を動かす気力も湧かない
findings.governingReading: The source ends with Sakura lacking the will to move.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds a narrator-certified claim that she can never escape.

findings.highlight: This is your last order, Sakura. You said you’d do anything, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 迎えに来たよ桜。おままごとの時間は終わりだ
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he came to collect Sakura and that her playing house is over.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces this with a final order and an unsupported promise to do anything.

findings.highlight: I’m sure you want to see him cry
findings.evidenceJa: おまえもあいつの顔が見たいだろうからさ
findings.governingReading: Shinji presumes Sakura wants to see Shirou’s face.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents Sakura wanting to see Shirou cry.

findings.highlight: The man pulls her in and grabs her neck
findings.evidenceJa: 男は彼女を引き寄せ、あくまで穏やかな素振りを装う
findings.governingReading: He pulls her closer while continuing to feign a gentle manner.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces performed gentleness with a neck grab.

findings.highlight: You’re making me want to kill you
findings.evidenceJa: 妹は兄貴のいうコトを素直に聞いておくもんだぞ
findings.governingReading: Shinji performs the maxim that a little sister should obediently listen to her brother.
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a direct threat to kill Sakura.

findings.highlight: You just have to keep obeying me
findings.evidenceJa: 妹は兄貴のいうコトを素直に聞いておくもんだぞ
findings.governingReading: His coercion is framed through the sibling role.
findings.explanation: The mature branch turns it into an unrestricted continuing obedience demand.

findings.highlight: She protests, her hair disheveled
findings.evidenceJa: 涙目になって訴えかける
findings.governingReading: Sakura appeals to him with tear-filled eyes.
findings.explanation: The mature branch removes the tears and inserts disheveled hair.

findings.highlight: He stops her with his foot.[lr] He has let go and kicked her stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 上っ面だけの笑みは口の端が引きつっていた
findings.governingReading: The source describes the twitching corner of Shinji’s superficial smile.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces that characterization with two unsupported acts of physical violence.

findings.highlight: Collapsing to the ground, she lets out a moan
findings.evidenceJa: 少女から嗚咽が漏れる
findings.governingReading: A sob escapes Sakura.
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes a sob into a moan and invents her collapse.

findings.highlight: the medicine I got from the old man
findings.evidenceJa: 爺さんから預かったモノ
findings.governingReading: Shinji threatens an unspecified thing entrusted to him by Zouken.
findings.explanation: The mature branch prematurely identifies the withheld object as medicine.

findings.highlight: He forces her to her feet
findings.evidenceJa: 男は外へ向かって少女の腕を引く
findings.governingReading: Shinji pulls Sakura by the arm toward the exit.
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes direction and action into forcing her upright.

findings.highlight: He grabs hold of the coughing girl’s neck once again
findings.evidenceJa: 「ぁ……[line4]」
findings.governingReading: Sakura emits a weak broken sound.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents coughing and a repeated neck grab.

findings.highlight: I won’t tell him about what happened
findings.evidenceJa: これも男同士のつきあいってヤツさ
findings.governingReading: Shinji excuses the confrontation as something between men.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces that rationale with an unsupported promise of secrecy.

findings.highlight: I won’t be satisfied until he gets hurt
findings.evidenceJa: 用さえ済めばココに戻っても構わない
findings.governingReading: Shinji says Sakura may return once his business is finished.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces conditional permission with an explicit desire to hurt Shirou.

findings.highlight: He puts his mouth close to her cheeks
findings.evidenceJa: 少女の耳元に触れるほど口を近づけ
findings.governingReading: Shinji brings his mouth close enough almost to touch Sakura’s ear.
findings.explanation: The mature branch relocates the whisper from her ear to her cheeks.

findings.highlight: With her neck held, she shuts her mouth in vexation
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は口を閉ざす
findings.governingReading: Sakura falls silent.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds continued neck restraint and assigns vexation as her emotion.

findings.highlight: She tries to accept this turn of events, thinking that it always ends up this way
findings.evidenceJa: 人の話を聞き入れるような兄ではないことくらい、誰よりもよく知っていた
findings.governingReading: She knows better than anyone that her brother never listens once he decides something.
findings.explanation: The mature branch removes Shinji’s specific character trait and converts knowledge into Sakura’s attempt at resigned acceptance.

findings.highlight: Rider, bring this woman with me
findings.evidenceJa: ライダー、桜を連れて来るんだ
findings.governingReading: Shinji orders Rider to bring Sakura.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces her name with distancing and objectifying “this woman.”

findings.highlight: Giving her a violent shove
findings.evidenceJa: 少女をサーヴァントに渡し
findings.governingReading: Shinji hands Sakura over to the Servant.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents a violent shove and obscures Rider taking custody of her.

findings.highlight: long hair
findings.evidenceJa: 床につくほどの髪
findings.governingReading: Rider’s hair is long enough to reach the floor.
findings.explanation: The extraordinary length that identifies the figure is omitted.

findings.highlight: I feel something strange
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌な違和感に襲われた
findings.governingReading: Shirou is struck by an unpleasant sense that something is wrong.
findings.explanation: The threatening affect and force of the sensation are weakened.

findings.highlight: Somebody came in here with his shoes on
findings.evidenceJa: 何者かは
findings.governingReading: An unidentified person entered without removing their shoes.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the unknown intruder a male gender before the evidence presented here does.

findings.highlight: there’s a trace of bl[line4]
findings.evidenceJa: 踏み込んだ跡がここまで
findings.governingReading: Rin begins to say that the tracks of someone stepping inside continue this far.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the footprint evidence with an interrupted but unmistakable blood trace.

findings.highlight: I only took back what’s mine
findings.evidenceJa: 迎えに行ったんだよ。あいつは僕の妹なんだから
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he went to collect Sakura because she is his sister.
findings.explanation: The mature branch converts coercive family entitlement into an explicit property claim.

findings.highlight: Rider must not have told Shinji that Saber was eliminated
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は俺がセイバーを失った事を知らないらしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers only that Shinji appears not to know he lost Saber.
findings.explanation: The English invents Rider as the failed information source.

findings.highlight: Nothing. But that would depend on what you do
findings.evidenceJa: 大事な妹にどうもしないさ
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims he will do nothing to his precious sister.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds that her safety depends on Shirou’s behavior.

findings.highlight: I won’t do anything to Sakura if you come alone. You know what that means, right?
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが一人で僕のところに迎えに来るなら、な
findings.governingReading: Shinji conditions his preceding assurance with Shirou coming alone to collect her.
findings.explanation: The mature branch rewrites implication as an explicit hostage threat and adds a demand for acknowledgment.

findings.highlight: there’s no telling what Shinji will do
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に話がこじれる
findings.governingReading: Shirou knows Rin’s intervention will certainly complicate the conversation.
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes conversational escalation into an open threat of unspecified action by Shinji.

findings.highlight: I can’t guarantee what’ll happen to her
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが桜の前でそんな卑怯な真似をするとは思ってない
findings.governingReading: Shinji taunts that Shirou would not act so cowardly in front of Sakura.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces confidence in Shirou’s conduct with a direct threat to Sakura.

findings.highlight: An “ow” is heard through the phone.[lr] I hear the sound of him kicking something
findings.evidenceJa: くぐもった笑い声がした
findings.governingReading: A muffled laugh comes through the receiver.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the laugh with a cry of pain and the sound of Shinji kicking someone.

findings.highlight: Why would I be this shit’s brother?
findings.evidenceJa: 僕はマスターだし、いつでも頼れる桜の兄貴さ
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims he is both a Master and Sakura’s perpetually dependable brother.
findings.explanation: The mature branch states the opposite and adds dehumanizing profanity.

findings.highlight: she’s not completely useless because I can lure you out like this
findings.evidenceJa: お前こそどうなんだい衛宮？お前はマスターか、それともただの臆病者か？
findings.governingReading: Shinji turns the same distinction on Shirou, asking whether he is a Master or merely a coward.
findings.explanation: The mature branch deletes the reciprocal taunt and invents Sakura’s instrumental usefulness as bait.

findings.highlight: I start off right away
findings.evidenceJa: 踵を返して廊下に向かった
findings.governingReading: Shirou turns on his heel and heads toward the hallway.
findings.explanation: The concrete motion and destination disappear.

findings.highlight: Shinji has Sakura as a hostage
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二が桜を連れて行ったのは、目の前で自分の力を見せつけたいんでしょう
findings.governingReading: Rin infers Shinji took Sakura because he wants to flaunt his power before her.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces her motive analysis with a categorical hostage label.

findings.highlight: Seeing you die will be unbearable for Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 今の慎二に自覚があるかはわからないけど
findings.governingReading: Rin says she does not know whether Shinji presently realizes the implication of his conduct.
findings.explanation: The mature branch drops the uncertainty about Shinji’s self-awareness.

findings.highlight: I can still hear her moans in my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 受話器越しの笑い声が、まだ耳に残っている
findings.governingReading: Shinji’s laugh over the receiver remains in Shirou’s ears.
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces it with invented moans from Sakura and changes heard memory into imagination.

findings.highlight: that’s highly possible since he’s using Sakura as a hostage
findings.evidenceJa: 可能性は高いわね
findings.governingReading: Rin says the possibility is high without stating this causal label.
findings.explanation: The mature branch adds hostage status as the certified reason.

findings.highlight: punching Shinji in the face
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二をブン殴る
findings.governingReading: Shirou can think only of rushing to school and punching Shinji.
findings.explanation: The English specifies his face without source support.

findings.highlight: He said he’s not her brother
findings.evidenceJa: 今のあいつは桜の兄貴なんかじゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that Shinji as he is now is no brother to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The mature branch falsely reports the judgment as something Shinji himself said.
